$comment: Which model and thinking effort each kind of agent starts on (ADR 0057 tiers, ADR 0062 efforts). The one table: the app reads it in ui/src/lib/ai/modelIds.ts for templates, the builder and new agents, and the daemon reads it for Ask's list_models, so every way of making an agent chooses alike. Quality comes first (2026-10-18): every job that gathers for the work, produces it, decides it or checks it is on the strong or check tier. Moving one to the fast tier is a one-line change here, to try once the quality benchmark shows the work stays as good. `models` name each tier's model first, as OpenRouter ids; who pays for it comes after (ADR 0073, ruled 2026-10-19): a connected plan that offers it (the Claude API credit for Anthropic's models, the ChatGPT plan for OpenAI's), else OpenRouter. Only when neither can run it does a connected plan's own model for the tier stand in: `bySource` names it, and `preference` says which connected plan's comes first.

tiers.strong: an agent that gathers what the work rests on, writes it, decides it or reviews it: research, writing, designing, leading, analysis, code
tiers.fast: short supporting work that judgement does not hang on: reformatting, simple lookups
tiers.check: a check step, read on another maker's model so it doesn't share the writer's blind spots
